description.p: rustnior is a lightweight image viewer in the spirit of Viewnior: it opens instantly, shows images as fast as they can be decoded and keeps the interface out of the way.

ul.li: Browse a folder with the keyboard, mouse wheel or a thumbnail strip
GPU zooming and panning, fit to window, 100% and smooth zoom
Rotate and flip, with lossless saving for JPEG
Fullscreen, slideshow and animated GIF, PNG, WebP and JPEG XL
JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, TIFF, BMP, SVG, AVIF, HEIC, JPEG XL and more
EXIF orientation and metadata, copy to clipboard, set as wallpaper
Handles images of hundreds of megapixels without freezing
